The full primary article’s reset rule, interaction integral, equation (23) and anti-phase discussion were inspected in lawful accessible HTML. This is a correction to the printed model equation, NOT proof that author code, numerical plots or first-order reduction itself are wrong. Pure algebra, no finite simulation.
